collection.title: Volkswagen Golf Estate 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Golf Estate 2020 - 2022 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
